title: ISS securities: engines/stock/markets/bonds
description: Bonds on the MOEX stock engine. Main-mode boards: TQOB, TQCB, TQRD, TQUD, TQOY, TQOD, TQOE (the primary board of a bond is picked by AFB's bonds/classify.pick_primary_board_row). Deliberately has no x-iss-marketdata: the market stays out of the generic marketdata cycle; bond quotes come from the bonds channel's own refresh and candles are addressed by the explicit market/board of the instrument.
